subject: general
question: Who among the following was one of the speakers after Jawaharlal Nehru to address the Parliament on the midnight of 15 August 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There were three main speakers at the Central Hall of Parliament.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru, Chaudhary Khaliquzaman, and Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
 
• Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru was the third notable speaker at the official event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jawahar Lal Nehru delivered his famous 'Tryst With Destiny' speech in Parliament. 
 
• On August 15, 1947, Jawaharlal Nehru was sworn in as PM of independent India.
 
• Vande Mataram was sung as the National Song.
